title: Hall's orders said he could never be briefed or debriefed

tellings.quote: >> I can never be briefed. I can never be debriefed. And the reason is very simple.

plain: From 1965 to 1967, a former Air Force man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Indian Springs on Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, was under orders saying he could never be briefed or debriefed, meaning never formally told the rules of a secret programme on entering or released from them on leaving. Hall tells it himself, saying "the reason is very simple," and he mentions a being he calls the Teacher, which suggests his work there sat outside any normal secret programme.
